_meta.rule: T25 — Spot the Difference (techniques.md ~l. 794) + Bug v5 (~l. 1004)
_meta.rule_quote: Une différence explicite doit être concrète, visuelle et localisée. `tap closed -> tap open + bucket` fonctionne. `one single change applied` est trop vague — modèle reproduit la même scène.
_meta.coverage: Couvre les 18 leafs annotés des 2 workflow_classes Comparatif (10 + 8) dans poc-scale-benchmark.

rainwater_collection_barrel.before_state: an empty rain barrel standing under a roof gutter, no water inside, dry ground around the barrel
rainwater_collection_barrel.after_state: the same barrel now full of water with a small stream of rainwater pouring from the gutter into the barrel, a watering can being filled from the tap at the bottom

kid_recycling_bin_sorting.before_state: a child standing next to a single overflowing trash bin with mixed items piled around (paper, plastic bottle, banana peel)
kid_recycling_bin_sorting.after_state: the same child smiling next to three separate labeled bins (paper, plastic, organic), each item placed in the correct bin, no mess on the ground

beach_cleanup_volunteers.before_state: a beach scene with scattered plastic bottles, bags and bits of trash on the sand, no people
beach_cleanup_volunteers.after_state: the same beach now clean with two volunteers carrying full trash bags, a garbage bag set on the sand, the sand free of debris

compost_bin_in_garden.before_state: an empty open compost bin in a garden, vegetable peels and dry leaves piled outside the bin on the ground
compost_bin_in_garden.after_state: the same bin now closed with the lid on, the peels and leaves placed inside through the open top, a single seedling sprouting from the soil next to the bin

earth_with_protective_hands.before_state: a planet earth alone floating, a few wilting trees and a smoke cloud drawn on its surface
earth_with_protective_hands.after_state: the same earth held gently between two cupped human hands from below, the trees on its surface now upright with leaves, no smoke cloud

solar_panels_on_roof.before_state: a simple house with a plain empty sloped roof, a tall power line pole next to the house
solar_panels_on_roof.after_state: the same house with a row of solar panels mounted on the sloped roof, a small sun shape drawn above sending lines toward the panels, the power line pole removed

polar_bear_on_melting_ice.before_state: a polar bear standing on a wide thick ice floe, snow piled around, calm sea below
polar_bear_on_melting_ice.after_state: the same polar bear now perched on a small thin cracked ice floe, water around with a few floating ice fragments, a sad expression on the bear
polar_bear_on_melting_ice.comment: Cas 12 deforestation validé presque parfait avec Insight C — pattern suivi pour climate-change leafs.

wind_turbines_on_hill.before_state: a green hill with a tall smoking factory chimney at the top, dark smoke rising into the sky
wind_turbines_on_hill.after_state: the same hill now topped by three wind turbines with spinning blades, no chimney, clear sky

kid_planting_a_tree.before_state: a child holding a small tree sapling and a shovel, an empty round hole dug in the ground in front of them
kid_planting_a_tree.after_state: the same child standing next to a young tree planted in the hole, the shovel resting on the ground, a watering can pouring water at the base of the tree

deforestation_before_after.before_state: a dense forest with many tall trees standing close together, small animals visible between the trunks
deforestation_before_after.after_state: the same area now bare with only a few stumps and a single fallen log, no animals, a tractor or chainsaw in the corner

vegetable_garden_at_home.before_state: an empty rectangular garden plot with bare soil, a shovel and a watering can resting against a fence
vegetable_garden_at_home.after_state: the same plot now planted with rows of leafy vegetables (lettuce, carrot tops, tomato plants on stakes), the watering can tipped pouring a few drops

electric_car_charging.before_state: a parked car with its fuel cap open and a fuel pump nozzle inserted, a gasoline pump station behind
electric_car_charging.after_state: the same car now plugged into an electric charging station via a cable connected to a charging port, a small lightning bolt symbol on the station

reusable_shopping_tote_bag.before_state: a shopper holding several thin plastic bags filled with items, one bag has a torn corner letting an apple fall out
reusable_shopping_tote_bag.after_state: the same shopper now holding one sturdy reusable cloth tote bag full of the same items, no torn bag, no items falling

eco_friendly_house_with_panels.before_state: a plain house with a smoking chimney on the roof, a tall power line pole next to it, a closed window
eco_friendly_house_with_panels.after_state: the same house with solar panels on the roof, a small wind turbine in the yard, the chimney no longer smoking, an open window with a plant on the sill

zero_waste_kitchen.before_state: a kitchen counter cluttered with disposable items (plastic water bottles, paper plates, plastic cutlery, a full trash can overflowing nearby)
zero_waste_kitchen.after_state: the same counter now tidy with glass jars of bulk goods, a reusable cloth bag, a metal water bottle, the trash can replaced by a small compost bin

bike_to_work_commute.before_state: a person standing next to a car in a long traffic jam on a road, smoke coming from several exhaust pipes
bike_to_work_commute.after_state: the same person now riding a bicycle on a clear bike lane next to the road, a backpack on their back, the traffic jam still visible but smaller in the background

kids_picking_up_litter.before_state: a park scene with scattered litter on the grass (cans, papers, a plastic bag), no children present
kids_picking_up_litter.after_state: the same park now clean with two children holding a full trash bag and a litter grabber tool, the grass clear, a single bird on a branch

reusable_water_bottle.before_state: a single-use plastic water bottle lying empty crumpled on its side, a discarded bottle cap nearby
reusable_water_bottle.after_state: a sturdy reusable metal water bottle standing upright, closed with its cap on top, a small water droplet symbol next to it
